title: Third-person -s in fast speech
what: dropping the -s on he/she/it verbs when speaking quickly ('She work in finance', 'It depend on the client')
summary: This subtle omission often persists because the meaning remains clear, even at advanced levels. However, it can subtly undermine a speaker's perceived precision and command of English grammar.
listenFor: Pay close attention to verbs ending in -s when the subject is 'he,' 'she,' or 'it,' especially in rapid speech.
